# controller

```go
import "github.zhaw.ch/raycasters/server/room/controller"
```

controller is a package responsible for all the game flow\. It controls every aspect from registration over message broadcast to player movement handling among other tasks\.

## Constants

HubClientLimit is the absolute upper limit supported by a single hub\. This limitation comes from the decision to only support a player id of size uint8\.

```go
const HubClientLimit = math.MaxUint8
```

## Variables

```go
var (
    // ErrHubIsFull is the error that is returned on an RegisterClient error.
    ErrHubIsFull = errors.New("the hub is currently filled to capacity")
    // ErrHubIsNotRunning is the error that as the name implies
    // means that the hub is currently not active.
    ErrHubIsNotRunning = errors.New("hub is not running")
    // ErrHubIsAlreadyRunning is the error returned if the
    // hub is already running.
    ErrHubIsAlreadyRunning = errors.New("hub is already running")
    // ErrHubIsStillStartingUp is the error returned if the
    // hub is still in the process of starting its
    // subsystems.
    ErrHubIsStillStartingUp = errors.New("hub is still starting up")
)
```

ErrHubControllerChangingMap is the error returned in the case that there is a map change currently going on\.

```go
var ErrHubControllerChangingMap = errors.New("the hub conrtroller is currently changing the map")
```

ErrHubControllerOffline is the error returned in the case that the controller is offline\.

```go
var ErrHubControllerOffline = errors.New("the hub controller is offline")
```
